subject: Packaging 'Tracelet' shim for LangChain/LlamaIndex — demo & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@sequence.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro — 'Tracelet' lightweight tracer for LangChain/LlamaIndex

Hi Karthik,

Quick intro — I'm Samir, Head of Integrations at Sequence AI. We build model observability and developer SDKs for ISVs. We've built a small open-source shim we call 'Tracelet' that captures prompt-level traces and structured prompt metadata from LangChain and LlamaIndex execution flows and emits a compact telemetry envelope.

We think a lightweight partner distribution that plugs into Redwood's runtime (for routing/credentials) and sends enriched traces back to Redwood's Console would be a low-effort win for both product teams and customers.

Attaching a short proposal and an architecture sketch for context. If this is interesting, we'd love to run a short pilot (4–6 weeks) with a small ISV customer and do a joint demo for our alliance channels.

Attachments: tracelet-proposal-v1.pdf; sequence-arch-draw.png

High-level asks:
- Simple integration pattern (drop-in shim + small wrapper for Redwood SDK).
- Guidance on supported runtime hooks (token-level correlation, request ids).
- A mutual action plan template and a point of contact for pilot ops.

Cc'ing Elena at PromptWorks — they helped us design the LlamaIndex adapter.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, Sequence AI
samir@sequence.ai
+1 415-555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@sequence.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — 'Tracelet' lightweight tracer for LangChain/LlamaIndex

Samir — really appreciate the note and the concise proposal. This aligns with a few things we're prioritizing for ISV partner flows: low-friction runtime adapters, clear tracing correlation, and a co-managed pilot playbook.

Quick answers and next steps:
1) Integration shape: we prefer a small runtime shim that uses our SDK hooks to add 'redwood_request_id' + model_variant metadata and forwards trace envelopes with an auth token. We'll ask infra to confirm exact hook names but this pattern is standard.
2) Pilot scope: 4 weeks (integration + QA) + 2 weeks for joint demo and feedback. We can host the pilot on Dedicated for predictable throughput.
3) Legal/ops: we can run the MAP (mutual_action_plan-template.xlsx) and I can introduce you to our partner ops.

Can you confirm Sequence AI's required retention for traces and whether you need any PII redaction by default? Also please share a brief sample trace envelope (sanitized) if possible.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to align resources — Vanessa (partnerships) and Marissa (developer relations) are looped in to coordinate the pilot and dev docs.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@sequence.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena@promptworks.io>
Date: Tue, 05 Nov 2025 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — 'Tracelet' lightweight tracer for LangChain/LlamaIndex

Thanks Karthik — great summary. A few clarifications below and I've attached a sanitized sample envelope.

- Retention: default 30 days for traces; for pilot we can hold 90 days if needed. We support configurable redaction rules.
- Sample envelope: attached 'tracelet-envelope-sample.json' (sanitized).
- Tech ask: we'll need a small token exchange (one-time service account token) and a route for webhook ingestion. TLS mutual auth is optional — we can use bearer tokens to start.

Proposed next steps:
- 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 11am PT to align teams (dev + security + partnerships).
- Exchange of a minimal SOW and MAP; we'll take a first pass on the SOW.

Attachments: tracelet-envelope-sample.json (stub)

See you tomorrow — Samir
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Nov 2025 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Tracelet pilot — quick ops notes

Folks — follow-up from Sequence AI. Samir is ready to run a 4–6 week pilot. Key ops bullets:
- Security: they want bearer token ingestion; security will want to review retention and redaction settings.
- Infra: pilot should run on Dedicated (small pool) to get stable latency numbers; we need to size GPU hours estimate.
- Dev: the shim is LangChain/LlamaIndex-focused; Marissa can own the sample SDK snippet and docs.
- GTM: Vanessa, let's draft a joint demo plan and decide customer targets (I suggested two existing ISVs who are already on our sandbox).

I'll forward Samir's attachments into the partner folder and book the 11am PT slot.

Karthik
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
